title: Chalk Full: Favorites Sweep Week 2, The Horse is Hea Wins by 60, and Three Teams Sit at 2-0
dek: Every favorite cashed, Sonny posted the week's top score with Patrick Mahomes on his bench, and No Banner only HULK now holds a 54% grip on Buckaroo Bowl IV.
body: Sonny's The Horse is Hea didn't just beat Jordan's Counting or not Counting GV; it lapped it. The final was 142.46 to 82.08, a 60.38-point margin that was both the week's top score and its biggest blowout. Jaxon Smith-Njigba did the heavy lifting with 38 points on a 15.22 projection, more than double what anyone expected. The scary part for the rest of the league: Patrick Mahomes scored 28.98 on Sonny's bench, so this rout came with room to spare. The Horse is Hea is 2-0, and its title odds jumped from 4% to 10%.

Ramon's No Banner only HULK keeps looking like the team everyone else is chasing. Josh Allen threw in 40.82 points on a 22.65 projection, the best line in the league, and the HULK flattened Zoe's Ghostu-Spider SZN 131.92 to 82.8 as a 67% favorite. Like Sonny, Ramon had plenty left in reserve, with Matthew Stafford (26.98) and Travis Kelce (20.6) both scoring on the bench. The HULK leads the league with 309.8 points, nearly 40 more than anyone else, and its title odds climbed from 47% to 54%. Brucie's Bills quarterback outscored entire position groups this week, and nobody in Chicago is thrilled about it.

Alan's Team Pillbert got into the win column with a 135.48 to 109.66 victory over Kaushal's Habibsters, the only true coin flip of the week at 51% pregame. Davante Adams went for 35.5 on a 13.14 projection, nearly tripling expectations. Alan was also busy before kickoff, adding Jalen Coker for Tony Pollard and Isaiah Likely for Sam LaPorta. Team Pillbert's title odds more than tripled, from 4% to 13%, now ahead of Sonny's 10% despite the worse record.

Kaushal deserves a sympathy card. CeeDee Lamb (31.3) and Dak Prescott (29.76) both made the week's top-performance list, a Dallas stack that delivered 61.06 points, and Habibsters still lost by 25.82. He also spent the week in a defense-swapping spiral, going from the Jaguars D/ST to the Buccaneers, then the 49ers, then back to the Buccaneers, and he traded Wan'Dale Robinson for Deebo Samuel Sr. before trading Deebo right back for Wan'Dale. The two-time champ is 0-2 with 218.3 points, more than 1-1 Ghostu-Spider SZN, and his playoff odds sit at 15%.

Randy's The fumblers won 124.02 to 100.74 at Mekhi's Dawgs, cashing as a 69% favorite on the road. Amon-Ra St. Brown carried the load with 30.7 on a 16.46 projection, which was handy, because Caleb Williams managed 7.72 against a 19.42 projection. The Bears quarterback disappointing his most loyal fan was the week's most Chicago sentence. The odd detail: Randy moved to 2-0 and his title odds still fell from 28% to 21%, largely because the HULK keeps swallowing the pie.

The rough weeks belonged to the bottom of the bracket. Zoe watched Saquon Barkley post 2.5 on a 16.38 projection and her title odds fell from 13% to 1%, though she did add Devaughn Vele as she reloads for a 1-1 team still holding 24% playoff odds. Jordan got 0.6 from Malik Nabers on a 12.26 projection, and JMoney's squad sits last with 158 points and 1% playoff odds. Mekhi is 0-2 with 9% playoff odds after swapping Carnell Tate for Kenyon Sadiq, a classic Kai wire move that will need to start paying off soon.

It was a chalk week from top to bottom: all four favorites won, and the standings now split cleanly into three 2-0 teams, two 1-1 teams, and three 0-2 teams. The HULK owns 54% of the title odds and 100% playoff odds, with The fumblers (21%), Team Pillbert (13%), and The Horse is Hea (10%) splitting most of what's left. Ghostu-Spider SZN and Habibsters are the only others above 1%, and both of them need wins soon.

Week 3 has two games that could reshape the top. Zoe's Ghostu-Spider SZN faces Randy's The fumblers, a Wisconsin-vs-Chicago matchup with a 1-1 rookie trying to knock off an unbeaten. The Horse is Hea hosts Dawgs, where Mekhi needs a win to keep his season from slipping away, and Habibsters draw the HULK, giving Kaushal a shot at the league favorite with his Dallas stack. Jordan gets Team Pillbert, hoping Alan's new tight end doesn't introduce himself loudly.

bios.1: Sonny's squad is 2-0 after the week's top score, a 142.46 beatdown of Counting or not Counting GV behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 38. Mahomes scored 28.98 on the bench, which is either a lineup problem or a depth flex. Title odds climbed from 4% to 10%.
bios.2: Randy is 2-0 after a 124.02 win at Dawgs, powered by Amon-Ra St. Brown's 30.7. Caleb Williams' 7.72 was a gut punch, and the title odds slid from 28% to 21% despite the win. Playoff odds sit at a healthy 92%.
bios.3: Jordan is 0-2 with a league-low 158 points after an 82.08 showing against The Horse is Hea, where Malik Nabers scored 0.6. Playoff odds sit at 1%. Team Pillbert is next, and a first win would change the mood fast.
bios.4: Alan is 1-1 after a 135.48 win over Habibsters, led by Davante Adams' 35.5. He kept tinkering, adding Isaiah Likely and Jalen Coker, and the model rewarded him with title odds of 13%, up from 4%. Counting or not Counting GV is next.
bios.5: Mekhi is 0-2 after a 124.02 to 100.74 loss to The fumblers, with playoff odds down to 9%. He swapped Carnell Tate for Kenyon Sadiq looking for a spark. A visit from 2-0 The Horse is Hea is a big ask.
bios.6: Kaushal is 0-2 despite 218.3 points and a 61-point Dallas stack from CeeDee Lamb and Dak Prescott this week. A week of shuffling defenses and receivers left the roster about where it started. Playoff odds are 15%, and the HULK is up next.
bios.7: Ramon's juggernaut is 2-0 with a league-best 309.8 points and 54% title odds, and Josh Allen's 40.82 this week was the best line in the league. The HULK left Stafford and Kelce scoring on the bench and still won by 49. Everyone else is playing for second until proven otherwise.
bios.8: Zoe's rookie season hit its first speed bump with an 82.8 loss to the HULK, sunk by Saquon Barkley's 2.5. She's 1-1 with 24% playoff odds and added Devaughn Vele heading into a Wisconsin-vs-Chicago date with The fumblers.
